notes.title: A Heartfelt Thank You: From the Developer of SameShadow
notes.content:
Dear Gamers,

Thank you for your incredible interest and support for SameShadow: Fernando's Journey. Your enthusiasm, whether through playing the demos, beta testing, or simply showing your support, means the world to my family and I.

As a solo developer, I've poured over three years of my life into this project, juggling full-time work to support both my family and the game's development. It's been a labor of love, driven by a deep passion for crafting something truly special within the SameShadow universe.

Launching Fernando's Journey was a pivotal moment for me. It's a challenging game, designed to push your skills and strategic thinking to the limit. With a vast skill tree offering 115 different passive skills and abilities, mastering your fighting style requires time, dedication, and a willingness to strategize.

Stepping into the shoes of Fernando, you'll find yourself on a bridge before a fallen Ukrainian city, facing off against a relentless military force. But this isn't a walk in the park; it's a semi-realistic third-person shooter roguelike where every decision matters. Death is inevitable, but through careful planning and skillful execution, victory can be yours.

The randomized city ensures that no two playthroughs are the same, adding an element of unpredictability to every session. Your journey will be fraught with challenges, mirroring the struggles faced by the real-world inhabitants of Ukraine. But it's within these struggles that true victory lies.

Steam Next Fest provided an invaluable opportunity to gauge interest in Fernando's Journey, and the support from gamers like you has been humbling. Sales from this game will fuel the future of SameShadow, allowing me to expand and improve upon the foundation laid by Fernando's Journey.

If you've enjoyed the journey so far, I urge you to wishlist the game and follow along for future updates. SameShadow: Fernando's Journey will be available for sale after the February Steam Next Fest, and I can't wait to share more of this world with you.

Thank you once again for your unwavering support and for joining me on this incredible journey.

Best,
GrandPaw Games

notes.title: Critical Choices: Unveiling the Last Big Update - Alignment!
notes.content:
Dear Gamers,

Exciting news awaits on the horizon of SameShadow: Fernando's Journey! Before the Steam Next Fest, we're thrilled to introduce the final significant update to our Skill Tree - the much-anticipated [b]"Alignment" [/b]system. This game-changing addition offers eight unique passive skills, each with both positive and negative buffs, reshaping your entire gameplay experience. Get ready to make strategic decisions and tailor your journey with these Alignments, each costing 3 awaken points:

[u][b]Alignment List:[/b][/u]

[b]-Warmonger:[/b] Deal and take 50% more Melee and Bullet damage.
[b]-Pacifism:[/b] Deal and take 50% less Melee and Bullet damage.
[b]-Ragdoll God:[/b] Deal 200% more Ragdoll damage and become Unlucky.
[b]-Luck Goddess: [/b]Get 50% more Luck. Deal no Ragdoll damage and take more Ragdoll damage.
[b]-Energy Purity:[/b] Increase your base Energy by 50% and Decrease your base Health by 60%.
[b]-Health Purity:[/b] Increase your base Health by 50% and Decrease your base Energy by 60%.
[b]-Self Destruct:[/b] Deal and take 33% more Explosive damage, Rage Radius Increased by 25% and drastically hinder your Teleportation Range.
[b]-Last Stand:[/b] Deal and take 33% less Explosive damage, Rage Radius Increased by 25% and Drastically hinder your Teleportation Range
[b]Spirit Over Might: [/b]Increase your Energy by 50% and Decrease your Bullet Damage by 50%
[b]Vigor Over Power: [/b]Increase your Health by 50% and Decrease your Melee Damage by 50%
[b]I Am Become Death:[/b] Increase your Energy and Health by 100%. Your Energy and Health Passive Regeneration restores 125% more. Deal 50% more Melee, Bullet, Ragdoll and Explosive Damage. -This can be Awaken after receiving "Burn it all Down" Achievement. (It will not work if not connected to Steam)


[i]Choose Wisely![/i] The downside could be a huge hindrance in the future. Prepare for a game-altering experience as you explore the diverse strategies each Alignment offers. Thank you for being part of SameShadow: Fernando's Journey, and stay tuned for more thrilling updates!

Best,
GrandPaw Games

notes.title: Entering the Invaded City
notes.content:
Dear Gamers,

Enter the grim abyss of the fallen Ukrainian city within "SameShadow: Fernando's Journey," a haunting landscape teeming with untold tales of despair and resilience:

Embark on a daunting journey through a dark, fog-laden city, the lingering stench of death a chilling testament to the desolation that reigns. Amidst the chaos, once-vibrant buildings now stand as eerie relics—some abandoned, others torn asunder by the desperate attempts of those fleeing the war. Tragic remnants bear witness to the misfortunes of those who couldn't escape.

Within these desolate streets, enemy soldiers meticulously scour block by block, erasing all traces of resistance. Yet, amidst their unwavering confidence in overwhelming military might, emerges an unforeseen force—YOU. The shadowy figure they never anticipated, swiftly ending their overconfidence.

As a solo game developer, crafting this vast urban battleground has been a monumental feat. My goal was to create an immersive city atmosphere, despite the limitations of not having a sizable team backing the project. Your feedback fuels the expansion of this city's variety, ensuring that each playthrough offers a more unique and dynamic experience than the last through randomization.

Immerse yourself in this war-torn environment, where chilling fog cloaks lurking terror. Traverse run-down streets and shattered ruins, wielding your awakened teleportation powers to sway the balance in this relentless struggle.

Refer to the "What happens after you die?" post for insights into the nuanced death mechanics crucial within this conflict-ridden terrain.

Thank you for your unwavering interest in "SameShadow: Fernando's Journey." Delve into this world of challenge and strategy—Happy Gaming!

Best,
GrandPaw Games

notes.title: Available Abilities in SameShadow: Fernando's Journey!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Gamers,[/b]

[h2]Unleash an arsenal of unique abilities in SameShadow, each a key to mastering your journey[/h2]

[i]Abilities Requiring Ability Slot:[/i]

[b]Time Dominion: [/b]Slow time to unleash devastating attacks, but beware of health and energy drain.

[b]Vanish: [/b]Leach enemy health and make them vanish, yet bosses resist this skill.

[b]Particle Acceleration:[/b] Blast foes back with ragdoll damage, upgrade range, and width for tactical advantage.

[b]Bullet Rush:[/b] Hurl bullets for potent long-range strikes—ideal for diversifying your combat style.

[b]Rapid Regeneration: [/b]Sacrifice energy for rapid healing, ensuring resilience in the face of adversity.

[b]Reduced Friction:[/b] Erect an energy shield against high-velocity threats, sustain it with upgraded activation.

[b]Rage: [/b]Channel remaining energy for explosive area damage, turning the tide of close combat battles.

[b]Disarm: [/b]Disarm your enemies to turn the tide of the fight in your favor. 

[b]Blood Lust:[/b] Take your deep desires for melee combat with upgraded damage and healing for a limited time.

[b]Shattered Earth: [/b]Destroy the earth beneath you sending enemies flying back and regain some life force. 

[b]Particle Desolation:[/b] Take Particle acceleration ability to it's most ferocious level. 


[i]Abilities without Requiring Ability Slot:[/i]

[b]Tele Jump:[/b] Ascend effortlessly without fear of fall damage, granting strategic advantage.

[b]Tele Knife Throw:[/b] Precision strikes without an Ability Slot, aiming for lethal accuracy.

[b]Sword Master:[/b] Elevate your swordplay to unmatched speeds and finesse.

[b]Tele Drop: [/b]Teleport enemies skyward, inflicting impactful ragdoll damage upon their descent.

[b]Tele Missile: [/b]Teleport enemy vehicles skyward, creating your personal rods of God upon their descent.

With 115 Passive Skills and Abilities, there is a build for everyone! 

[b]Embark on a journey of mastery, wielding abilities in SameShadow's Prologue, SameShadow: Fernando's Journey![/b]

Best,
GrandPaw Games

notes.title: What happens after you die?
notes.content:
Dear Gamers,

What happens after you die? In "SameShadow: Fernando's Journey," death isn't the end—it's a part of a cyclical journey.

Upon death, you enter a Death-Reborn Cycle, allowing a limited number of respawns: more on easy mode, 10 times on normal, and 5 times on Hard mode. However, each death entails losing equipment, retaining only unlocked abilities and the sword.

As you approach the cycle limit, a skull icon, initially opaque with empty eyes, gradually becomes clearer after each death. Red eyes signify "Game Over," indicating a need to restart. This Rogue Lite mechanic adds intensity and strategy.

On Hard mode, fewer respawns and XP loss present a challenging experience. Reversing the cycle requires leveling up—earned by defeating enemies. Leveling grants experience and awakening points, which are used to unlock powerful abilities in the Skill Tree.

When reborn, a limited-time invulnerability protects you, extendable through the Skill Tree as a passive skill, offering strategic advantages. You can also trigger a deliberate death (by pressing 7) after the invulnerability timeframe ends, resulting in a standard respawn.

In essence, avoiding death is key. Enemies become deadlier with increased awareness, no action warnings, and the ability to headshot. To survive, strategic awareness and stealth become essential.

Thank you for exploring SameShadow: Fernando's Journey!

Best,
GrandPaw Games
